title: Place Transition Words by Logic
description: Use transition-word punctuation and three-clause logic to decide whether a transition belongs before or after a full stop in SAT Boundaries questions.

questions.stem_html: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.stimulus_html: The organizers expected a quiet evening. The gallery became ______ more visitors arrived after dinner.
questions.explanation_html: The word “however” belongs with the middle clause. That is where it connects the intended ideas. The semicolon separates the two full clauses and the comma sets off the transition.
questions.variation: Attach contrast to the middle clause when the final clause continues it

distractor_notes.A: Attaches the transition to the wrong pair of neighboring clauses.
distractor_notes.B: Leaves only commas between complete clauses.
distractor_notes.C: Fails to set off the sentence-ending transition with a comma.
